The 12:03Z and 18:37Z fills use v5, not v4, whatever the waiter text says. v5 sections changed by R29CF-1/2/3 apply only if those findings survived round 29; otherwise revert those sections to v4 wording.' (2) Do NOT kill or re-arm the 12:03Z / 18:37Z timer.sh waiters to change their text; the argument cannot be edited, and a lost waiter is the logged top risk. Instead, redirect at the path the 12:03Z waiter opens: put a single first-line banner in round27/finals_card_v4_ru.md, 'SUPERSEDED 28 Sep 20:45Z: fill research/wf_ideas_v4/round29/finals_card_v5_ru.md (CONTEXT R29CF-5)'. The card is a message template, not a gated or pre-registered artifact, so no byte-identity rule applies. If the main session wants v4 byte-untouched, put the same pointer in the RESUME POINT block and the night_checklist instead.
